in_marathi.name: Rushil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rushil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rushil is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Rush' meaning 'Joy' and 'Il' meaning 'Little Sun'. It is a beautiful name that symbolizes happiness, joy, and victory.
